description.zh: 应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The application name. View AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh: 查询结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过7天。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 7 days.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口获取某个域名或应用下的直播流操作历史。其中直播流操作指的是对这个直播流进行过的接口操作。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
The operations include all API operations that were called on live streams.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-streams-control-history --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
